Name: Malfoid
Author: AurumRunar
Description:
[b][color=#e06666][size=4]Description[/size][/color][/b]
Portrait replacer for different characters. Artstile inspired by Miru and OhoDavi

By now replacers avaiable for:
[list]
[*][b][color=#ff0000]new![/color][/b] Magnus (Wizard) - with sprites [/*]
[*]Camilla - Does not include sprites [/*]
[/list][color=#e06666][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install via mod manager[/*]
[*]Adjust dependencies - load this mod after all others[/*]
[*]Enjoy[/*]
[/list]If it does not work, you always can install portraits manually. Just replace original pngs in the dominant mod. Please, report a bug with load order in this case

[b][size=4][color=#e06666]Compatability, [/color][color=#ea9999]Requirements [/color][/size][/b]
Replacers should automatically work with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482?tab=posts]Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]SOSCA[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]  [/*]
[/list]And you need at least one of them

By manually replacing portraits inside a folder it might work with other mods

[b][color=#e06666][size=4]Discussion[/size][/color][/b]
This is merely an asset replacer. I am open to discuss making custom NPC mod. Contact me on Nexus if interested.

Maybe later I will make Haley replacer, more character sprites
